text:
devon: quick PSA — found a flaky curl example in runtime guide that causes the smoke CI to fail (staging). noticed while onboarding interns. link: https://internal.docs/runtime/curl#auth-sample :grimacing:
maria: ah ok. which snippet? can you paste the curl output error? :eyes:
devon: gist of it — the snippet uses REDWOOD_KEY but staging expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. CI shows 403 in the sample test. error: 

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"message":"invalid api key"}

snippet currently:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","input":"hi"}'
```
maria: oh yikes. small change but explains the 403. any anchor/link issues too?
devon: also saw the guide anchor id changed from #auth-sample to #auth-snippet in the last perf-docs edit, so the inline link in the quickstart 404s in staging preview. two fixes in one.
aj: I can take both. will update the env var in the snippet and fix the anchor ref. pushing branch aj/docs/curl-staging-fix.
aj: quick question — do we need to add a note about centered example being only for hosted API? or just keep it as-is?
samir: leave note. add a one-liner: "Note: replace with your project API key for non-hosted deployments." avoids support tickets. :+1:
aj: got it. PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/8421
maria: nice — can you include a tiny test in the docs CI that runs `curl --head` against the staging preview path to catch future anchor breaks?
aj: yeah will add a `curl -I` check for the snippet link in the doc build job. lightweight.
deploy-bot: deploy preview queued for aj/docs/curl-staging-fix (preview id: pv-9912)
devon: thanks everyone. tagging @oncall-docs for visibility in case the staging preview flakes. :wave:
maria: added assignment in the docs board and noted the sample test expectation.
samir: LGTM from me after CI passes.
aj: CI green on preview, merged. leaving a tiny changelog note in the commit. :tada:
